overall_summary: Analysis of current data shows a massive outperformance by husband-wife relationship dynamics compared to general poetry or parental emotional quotes. However, sample size is relatively small, so confidence is moderate with a preference for doubling down on the proven romantic/marital relationship dynamic while reserving a small experiment budget.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about wife understanding and post-marriage love (or5gtaBpRVY, my5mP9feI7s) achieved 1,666 and 1,766 views respectively, vastly outperforming all other topics which stayed below 400 views.
winning_patterns.action: Focus heavily on marital realities, misunderstandings, and emotional shifts in long-term relationships.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos relying purely on abstract sad shayari (e.g., YdWh4cDOE64 with 10 views) or generic quotes performed extremely poorly.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract shayari without a grounded everyday relationship situation attached to it.

next_video.concept: A couple who used to talk for hours on the phone before marriage now scrolling phones silently side-by-side in bed.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the sound of phone screen scrolling in a dark room at midnight.
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that instead of scrolling social media, they are actually re-reading their own old WhatsApp chats from 5 years ago.
next_video.reason: Matches the proven high-performing husband-wife relationship niche and targets evening leisure scrolling time when feelings of domestic nostalgia peak.

experiment: Testing if adding a digital-age nostalgic element to the successful husband-wife relationship format drives higher comment engagement.
